title: Refreshed. (OpenAI brand refresh)
arc: construction: a single black dot (the cursor) types a question, becomes a circle, is built up through geometry into a type system (OpenAI Sans glyphs, weights, scripts), into the wordmark and the blossom logo, into a colour palette, into photography ('the research is never done', 'artificial general intelligence that benefits all of humanity'), and finally into layouts that assemble a poster wall and resolve back to the wordmark.
world: Pure white ground, tiny mono construction labels at the frame edges, black Swiss-style grotesque for everything, hairline construction drawings (circles, bezier handles, ticks) before every filled form; colour appears only after the system is drawn (palette discs) and in photography.
actor: The dot: it types as the cursor behind 'What can I help with?', swells into the circle that is drawn as geometry, becomes the dot in the logo construction, the black disc that cycles brand colours, and the ember before photography. One point carries the whole film.

lines.show: A single black dot appears at the centre of a white frame and sits there; nothing else.
lines.handoff: The dot moves to the right end of a line as a typing caret.

lines.show: The dot is the caret: 'Wh', 'What', 'What ca', 'What can I he', 'What can I help with' typed at small size to its left; the dot trails each letter.
lines.handoff: The sentence is deleted from the left leaving 'I help with?' and the dot.

lines.show: The sentence deletes from the front ('I help with?' remains, then only the dot), the dot returns to the centre.
lines.handoff: The dot swells into a black disc.

lines.show: The dot grows into a solid black disc, which immediately becomes a hairline construction circle with an inscribed square, diagonals, then concentric rings and a radial dial with ticks (geometry drawn like a spec sheet).
lines.handoff: The rings tighten back into a single dot.

lines.show: The dial shrinks to a tiny dot; then the dot bursts into a dozen points that scatter into a loose cloud.
lines.handoff: The points settle on a dot grid inside a circle.

lines.show: The points settle onto a circular grid of tiny dots; a four-word list appears at the right ('Simplicity', 'Space', 'Imperfection', 'Vivid') with a bullet dot beside it that steps down the list as the dot field changes: one dot at the centre (simplicity), a six-dot ring (space), an irregular scatter at the periphery (imperfection), then the field floods with cyan, blue and yellow dots (vivid); each word names the state the dots are in.
lines.handoff: The coloured dots shrink back to a single black dot.

lines.show: The dots burst and fade; the list collapses to 'Simplicity / Space' then only a dot is left at the centre.
lines.handoff: A huge thin circle outline draws around the dot.

lines.show: A large hairline circle draws; tangent lines, small handle circles and an arc leader appear at the rim as if building a letterform; the circle opens into arcs.
lines.handoff: The arcs become the bowls of 'GPT' outlines.

lines.show: 'GPT' appears as thin outline letters with bezier handles and guide lines; the outlines are a draft of a typeface.
lines.handoff: A large solid letter drops in over its own outline.

lines.show: Single letters are shown huge in black, one at a time with their outline ghost behind: C, S, ?, i, A; each lands with a small bounce and the ghost of the previous one fades.
lines.handoff: The A multiplies into accented variants.

lines.show: The A fans into Á Ă Â Ä Ạ À Ā Ą ... and then the whole Latin set spills across the frame in rows, with single glyphs flashing blue, yellow, orange (the system is large).
lines.handoff: The sheet shrinks to a corner; a single lowercase glyph takes the centre.

lines.show: A giant 'a' in black appears with a grid of tiny construction (circle in a grid) at the left; it holds; then fades to outline.
lines.handoff: The outline turns into the 'Op' of the next word.

lines.show: 'Ope' then 'Op' set in rising weights down a column (Light -> Bold); the column is then 'OpenAI' repeated five times in weights, with names ('Light', 'Book', 'Regular', 'Medium', 'Bold') set at the right; the 'OpenAI Sans' label animates in with each row.
lines.handoff: The weight labels remain and the script list appears.

lines.line: OpenAI Sans Latin / Кириллица Cyrillic / Ελληνικά Greek / عربي Arabic / 한글 Hangul / עברית Hebrew / 日本語 Japanese / 中文 Chinese
lines.show: A list of scripts appears, each line centred in its own typeface, drawing in from the top down; each line is the script name in the script plus its English name.
lines.handoff: A huge '10' replaces the list.

lines.show: '10' is set huge in black, then a text block appears in its counter; '1' alone, '0' shrinks into a paragraph block of text: type scale demonstrated by size.
lines.handoff: The paragraph block becomes a title.

lines.line: Learning to Reason with LLMs - Chain of Thought - AI reasoning academic benchmarks 89% - 09-09
lines.show: A poster layout builds: huge 'L' and 'M' glyphs at the corners ('LLM' cropped), 'Learning to Reason with LLMs' in small bold at the left, 'Chain of Thought' at the right, a dense text paragraph in the middle, 'AI reasoning academic benchmarks 89%' at the right, date '09-09' at the bottom; everything snaps to the grid.
lines.handoff: The big letters mash into black blocks (RM N).

lines.show: Letters 'L', 'N', 'R', 'M' enlarge, overlap and clip into dense black blocks; they slide through each other.
lines.handoff: The blocks reveal a new layout.

lines.show: 'Introducing the Model Spec' small at the top left with a two-digit '6 4' number, a paragraph of body text; a huge Japanese '東京' crashes in at the right and stacks into a thick smeared black column with glitch.
lines.handoff: The kanji shifts into the next poster.

lines.show: 'Hyper Parameters' set vertically with a spaced number; 'A1-rt1f' becomes 'A1-rt1f1c13' by typing; 'oMG' overlaps 'o' and 'MG' as a giant type pun on the filename.
lines.handoff: The overlapping glyphs break into shapes.

lines.show: A black circle, triangle and a '1' fragment tumble in; '4o' appears huge (the 'o' as a circle) with a paragraph block at right; it outlines, then 'o3' replaces it while 'Learning to' ghosts; 'GPT-' then 'GPT-2', then small 'o1', each model name in a different size on the grid.
lines.handoff: Everything dissolves to a black disc.

lines.show: A black disc sits centre; it greys to white outline and goes down to a hairline circle with four dots.
lines.handoff: The hairline circle becomes the wordmark construction.

lines.show: A hairline circle (with four handles) shrinks, then points scatter into the shape of 'Open' as dotted outline, filling to the wordmark 'OpenAI' with measurement ticks beneath; the outline fills in black and holds.
lines.handoff: The word is cut to its parts: 'Chat' appears and replaces it.

lines.show: The wordmark's letters swap in place, 'OpenAI' -> 'Chat' -> 'ChatGPT' -> 'Sora' -> 'Research' (the same size and place): the product names as one system.
lines.handoff: The last word shrinks to a dot.

lines.show: The dot returns; a hairline circle opens, then a spirograph rosette of overlapping circles draws, then it resolves into the knot logo (outline), which draws in solid and then shrinks.
lines.handoff: The solid logo shrinks to a dot.

lines.show: The dot swells into a large black disc, inverts (white disc on a black band), then turns blue, light blue, lavender, royal blue, navy: the disc is a palette swatch cycled across the frame, each new colour sliding in from the right.
lines.handoff: The colours separate into a ring of six discs.

lines.show: Six discs (light blue, blue, white outline, black, lavender, navy, royal blue) cluster in a ring with a tiny label in each, each in its own position, as the brand palette.
lines.handoff: The discs shrink to confetti dots.

lines.show: The discs burst to small coloured dots that fill the frame in a loose field (orange, yellow, blue, pink, black), then implode to a single black dot.
lines.handoff: The dot becomes a gradient orb that swells into an ocean photo.

lines.show: The dot becomes a light-blue gradient orb (a wave texture), holds, then expands to fill the frame as a close-up wave photograph: the colour sample becomes the image.
lines.handoff: Words appear scattered across the sea.

lines.show: Words 'The', 'research', 'is', 'never', 'done' are placed on a staircase down the frame over the sea spray, tiny white, one word per beat; a bird flies across the sunset sky above them, crossing the line 'never' (the words and the bird share the diagonal).
lines.handoff: The sky shrinks to a small photo in a white frame beside a silhouette portrait.

lines.show: White frame holds a small sun-over-sea photo at the left and a tall silhouette of a man looking up at the right; the large portrait slowly turns up; the small sun glints.
lines.handoff: A new landscape fills the frame and words scatter on it.

lines.line: Input to output to pattern to meaning
lines.show: A sea stack at sunset with a wave moving; words scattered at the edges of the rock: 'Input' far left, 'output' and 'to' then 'pattern' above the rock, 'to' and 'meaning' at far right; the placement traces a path across the frame.
lines.handoff: The frame shrinks to a grassy cliff photo on white.

lines.show: A small green cliff photo and a larger red-orange rock-pool photo with grass tile in on white, each sliding in a different direction.
lines.handoff: A dark coastline takes the whole frame.

lines.line: Artificial general intelligence that benefits all of humanity
lines.show: A coastline at dusk: words 'Artificial', 'general', 'intelligence', 'that', 'benefits', 'all', 'of', 'humanity' land one at a time stepping diagonally down from upper left to lower right across the sky and sea, mirroring a staircase.
lines.handoff: The frame cuts to white with a couple at sunset.

lines.show: Three portrait-format photos in turn on white: a couple holding hands into a sun flare, a hand in sea foam, a lit sea stack at golden hour; each photo scales in as a card, no words.
lines.handoff: A boy portrait leads to the layout system.

lines.show: A portrait photo on white becomes full-frame sunset above clouds with 'OpenAI' in white across it; the frame then returns to white and the wordmark in black sits in a box with corner marks.
lines.handoff: The box shows a grid inside which the words are laid out.

lines.show: A white layout box with vertical column lines: 'OpenAI' sits in the top left, 'ChatGPT' appears in the second column, 'Sora' lower; the box grows as a poster template while product names step through the layout.
lines.handoff: Image tiles start filling the template.

lines.show: 'Hyper Para Meters' sits in the middle column on three lines with butterfly-wing, rock and blue image tiles around it, a notebook page, a yellow card with a column of 'o3o3o3' ending with 'o3oMGo', orange and blue photo tiles sliding in; everything snaps to the column grid.
lines.handoff: Tiles continue to stack until the sheet is full.

lines.show: A dense collage: ferris wheel, big 'O', 'RM' glyph, green face block with 'OpenAI' in white, a big 'G', 'R', weight scale 300-700, grass, blue circle; tiles shuffle in and out in small steps; the collage is the brand system in use.
lines.handoff: The wall fades to white and the logo returns.

lines.show: The wall blinks out; a black knot logo sits alone in white.
lines.handoff: The logo is replaced by the wordmark.

lines.show: 'O', 'OpenA', 'OpenAI' types in black on white at the centre; held to the end.
lines.handoff: End hold.

techniques: one point (the dot) as cursor, circle, logo, swatch and ember
construction drawing before every filled form
type specimen as story (glyphs, weights, scripts)
word swap in place for the product names
palette as a disc cycled through colours
colour disc expands into a photograph
word-by-word staircase of text over footage
poster collage that snaps to a column grid
lessons: Carry the whole film on one primitive (a dot) and let every new idea be that dot growing: caret, circle, logo, palette, photograph.
Show how the thing is built before showing the thing: hairline construction first, solid fill after.
Make each brand principle behave as the dot does (one dot = simplicity; ring = space; scatter = imperfection; coloured field = vivid).
Use the specimen as plot: a glyph, its accents, its weights, its scripts, its numerals say the system is thorough without a single claim.
Land product names by swapping them in the same wordmark slot; the repetition is the brand system.
Give photography its own entrance: a colour sample swells into the image, words step across it as a staircase, then cut to white cards.
